faq.question: Is this course only for journalism students?
faq.answer: No. It also suits learners interested in digital media, PR, and communication strategy.

faq.question: What kind of outputs will I create?
faq.answer: You will work on story planning, communication tasks, and digital-first media exercises.

faq.question: Does the course reflect current media workflows?
faq.answer: Yes. The structure is built around platform-aware and audience-focused communication practice.

tasks.title: Viral Article Structure
tasks.assignment: Outline a viral article, complete with Meta Title, Description, and Header H1/H2 hierarchy.
tasks.ai_review: The AI checks exact character counts such as Meta Title under 60 chars, keyword density, and structural formatting.

tasks.title: Negative Sentiment Slack Alert
tasks.assignment: Set up an automation that tracks Twitter/X for a brand's name, runs sentiment analysis, and alerts a Slack channel if sentiment turns Negative.
tasks.ai_review: The AI pushes a negative JSON payload to the webhook to verify the routing logic fires correctly.

tasks.title: B2B Ad Targeting Parameters
tasks.assignment: Build the targeting parameters for a B2B ad campaign.
tasks.ai_review: The AI checks whether the budget allocation and audience exclusions are logically sound based on the given prompt.

tasks.title: Tracked Digital PR System
tasks.submission: Campaign logic, press release, and ROI dashboard setup.
tasks.assignment: Design a complete digital PR campaign, including the tracked email distribution logic, SEO-optimized press release, and automated ROI dashboard.
tasks.ai_review: The AI evaluates the campaign's trackability. If the student cannot prove how they will measure open rates and click-throughs, they fail.
